sentences.original_text: Welcome to English in a Minute.
sentences.translated_text: 歡迎收看「一分鐘學英語」。

sentences.original_text: And there are so many different flavors, like cherry, lemon, banana cream!
sentences.translated_text: 而且有好多不同的口味，像是櫻桃、檸檬、香蕉奶油！

sentences.original_text: But what could the idiom “pie in the sky” mean?
sentences.translated_text: 但是「pie in the sky（天上的派）」這個慣用語是什麼意思呢？

sentences.original_text: Pedro is finally moving to Hollywood to follow his acting dream.
sentences.translated_text: Pedro 終於要搬去好萊塢，追逐他的演員夢了。

sentences.original_text: He’s been talking about that for years.
sentences.translated_text: 這件事他已經講了好幾年了。

sentences.original_text: His plans are just pie in the sky.
sentences.translated_text: 他的計畫根本是空中樓閣。

sentences.original_text: His YouTube channel has over four million subscribers!
sentences.translated_text: 他的 YouTube 頻道有超過四百萬名訂閱者耶！

sentences.original_text: Anything “pie in the sky” could be great but probably won’t happen.
sentences.translated_text: 任何「pie in the sky」的事情或許很美好，但大概不會發生。

sentences.original_text: As an adjective, “pie in the sky” describes dreams, goals, or plans that are unlikely to become reality.
sentences.translated_text: 當作形容詞時，「pie in the sky」用來形容不太可能實現的夢想、目標或計畫。
